Metadata.title: JTypoSquatting — typosquatting detection
Metadata.description: Generate the variants of a domain name (typos, homoglyphs, extensions...) and find the ones that are registered and online.

Home.title: Find the domains that imitate yours
Home.lead: Typosquatters register domains almost identical to yours to phish your customers or capture their traffic. JTypoSquatting generates these variants and checks which ones are online.
Home.step1: 21 algorithms produce thousands of variants: typos, look-alike characters, extensions, hyphens, plurals…
Home.step2: Each variant is contacted: HTTP response, TLS certificate, title, language, screenshot.
Home.step3: Results arrive live and can be exported as CSV or JSON for your security or legal teams.

Algorithms.title: How it works
Algorithms.lead: Each scan applies 21 generation algorithms to the domain, then checks every variant.

families.charactersText: Omission, repetition, swap, addition or vowel change: exmple.com, exxample.com, exmaple.com.
families.keyboardText: Neighbouring keys on QWERTY and AZERTY keyboards: wxample.com, gppgle.com.
families.visualText: Look-alike characters from other alphabets: ехаmple.com (Cyrillic).
families.separatorsText: Hyphens added or removed, dots missing or added: ex-ample.com, wwwexample.com, ex.ample.com.
families.wordsText: Common misspellings, homophones, plurals, numbers as words: forseasons.com, shopforyou.com.
families.suffixesText: Other extensions, added extensions, wrong second level, dynamic DNS: example.fr, example.com.br, example.duckdns.org.

Algorithms.checks: For each variant: HTTP response, TLS certificate validity, page title, description and language, and a screenshot taken in an isolated browser. Checks less than 24 hours old are shared between users.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.q1: Does the service visit the sites it finds?
Faq.a1: Yes, from an isolated infrastructure and with an identifiable User-Agent. Your browser never contacts these sites, unless you open a link after the warning.
Faq.q2: How many scans can I run?
Faq.a2: Two simultaneous scans and fifty per 24-hour period, to keep the service fair.
Faq.q3: Why do some domains show strange characters?
Faq.a3: They are homoglyphs: characters from other alphabets that look identical. The technical form (punycode, xn--…) is shown as well.
Faq.a4: The site presents a self-signed or expired certificate, or one issued for another name. This is common on fraudulent domains.

Terms.body: The service is meant to protect your own brands and domains. Any use aimed at probing third-party sites at scale, bypassing quotas or harming others is forbidden. Full text to be validated by counsel before going live.

Privacy.body: We keep your identifier, your e-mail address and the history of your scans, to provide the service. Scans are deleted after 90 days. You can export your data or delete your account at any time from "My scans › My data". Data controller and contact: to be completed before going live.
